map.局部水头损失（本页代码口径）：h_L=局部阻力系数 K×流速 v²÷(2×重力加: Minor head loss (page code basis): h_L = loss coefficient K×velocity v²÷(2×gravity g) (m); linked values: velocity head = v²÷(2g) (m), pressure equivalent = h_L×9.81 (kPa, water). Validation: the three fields are required by the input guard and must be valid numbers, otherwise it prompts and stops. Verdict: no fixed grading; h_L is linear in K and proportional to the square of velocity — doubling velocity quadruples the loss.
